entries.query: What are the incidence and clinical outcomes of hyperkalemia in chronic kidney disease?

judgments.title: Elevated potassium levels in patients with chronic kidney disease: occurrence, risk factors and clinical outcomes-a Danish population-based cohort study.
judgments.rationale: The Danish population cohort directly measures hyperkalemia incidence, risk factors, hospitalization, and mortality in patients with CKD.

entries.query: Does ferric citrate alter FGF23 and PTH in iron-deficient nondialysis CKD with normal phosphate?

judgments.title: Effect of ferric citrate hydrate on FGF23 and PTH levels in patients with non-dialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease with normophosphatemia and iron deficiency.
judgments.rationale: The clinical trial evaluates ferric citrate hydrate and reports the named FGF23 and PTH outcomes in nondialysis CKD patients with iron deficiency.

entries.query: What efficacy and safety evidence exists for Tripterygium wilfordii in CKD?

judgments.title: Efficacy and safety of Tripterygium wilfordii Hook F for CKD in Mainland China: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: This systematic review and meta-analysis directly evaluates efficacy and safety of Tripterygium wilfordii Hook F for CKD.

entries.query: How do bivalirudin and heparin plus glycoprotein inhibitors compare in coronary disease with CKD?

judgments.title: Efficacy and safety of bivalirudin in coronary artery disease patients with mild to moderate chronic kidney disease: Meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: The meta-analysis compares bivalirudin with heparin plus GPIs in CAD patients with CKD and reports ischemic and bleeding outcomes.

entries.query: How is mild to moderate CKD associated with cardiovascular outcomes in people with dysglycemia in ORIGIN?

judgments.title: Chronic Kidney Disease, Basal Insulin Glargine, and Health Outcomes in People with Dysglycemia: The ORIGIN Study.
judgments.rationale: This post hoc ORIGIN analysis directly relates CKD stage to cardiovascular outcomes among people with dysglycemia and reports event risks.

entries.query: What are canagliflozin efficacy and safety findings in people with stage III CKD?

judgments.title: A Systematic Review on Effect of Canagliflozin in Special Population.
judgments.rationale: The review explicitly includes stage III CKD and summarizes canagliflozin efficacy and safety in special populations.

entries.query: Which clinical and genetic variables predict CKD in type 2 diabetes, and how were they validated?

judgments.title: Genetic and clinical variables identify predictors for chronic kidney disease in type 2 diabetes.
judgments.rationale: The study develops clinico-genomic CKD prediction models in T2D and tests selected genetic associations in independent cohorts and meta-analysis.

entries.query: Is physical activity associated with mortality among people with type 1 diabetes and CKD?

judgments.title: Physical Activity Reduces Risk of Premature Mortality in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes With and Without Kidney Disease.
judgments.rationale: A prospective observational FinnDiane analysis stratifies mortality associations of physical activity by CKD status in type 1 diabetes.

entries.query: What is the risk of NSAID-associated AKI in community adults and people with CKD?

judgments.title: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug induced acute kidney injury in the community dwelling general population and people with chronic kidney disease: systematic review and meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: The systematic review pools AKI risk estimates for current NSAID exposure in community adults and separately reports estimates for people with CKD.

entries.query: What long-term kidney and cardiovascular outcomes follow acute kidney injury?

judgments.title: Long-term Adverse Events Associated With Acute Kidney Injury.
judgments.rationale: This review summarizes long-term CKD, kidney failure, cardiovascular, and mortality consequences reported after AKI.

entries.query: What predicts mortality and dialysis dependence after AKI in hospitalized older adults?

judgments.title: Acute Kidney Injury in Elderly Population: A Prospective Observational Study.
judgments.rationale: The prospective study of hospitalized older adults evaluates AKI severity, renal replacement therapy, mortality, and dialysis dependence at discharge.

entries.query: What is known about contrast-associated AKI risk after coronary angiography and intervention?

judgments.title: Current Risk of Contrast-Induced Acute Kidney Injury After Coronary Angiography and Intervention: A Reappraisal of the Literature.
judgments.rationale: This literature reappraisal addresses contrast-induced AKI after coronary angiography and intervention, including risk factors and uncertainty about causation.

entries.query: Does 5-aminolevulinic acid protect against rhabdomyolysis-induced AKI through Nrf2?

judgments.title: 5-Aminolevulinic acid exerts renoprotective effect via Nrf2 activation in murine rhabdomyolysis-induced acute kidney injury.
judgments.rationale: The mouse AKI study tests 5-aminolevulinic acid and reports renal function, tubular damage, oxidative stress, and Nrf2-associated findings.

entries.query: Which cognitive domains improve after kidney transplantation compared with dialysis or CKD care?

judgments.title: Meta-analysis of cognitive functioning in patients following kidney transplantation.
judgments.rationale: The meta-analysis compares post-transplant cognitive domains with pre-transplant function, dialysis or conservative CKD care, and healthy controls.

entries.query: Do early post-transplant biomarkers predict five-year kidney graft loss?

judgments.title: Analysis of Biomarkers Within the Initial 2 Years Posttransplant and 5-Year Kidney Transplant Outcomes: Results From Clinical Trials in Organ Transplantation-17.
judgments.rationale: The CTOT-17 cohort links early post-transplant biomarker and eGFR changes to five-year kidney allograft outcomes and graft loss.

entries.query: Which glomerular diseases recur after kidney transplantation and what treatments are discussed?

judgments.title: Recurrent glomerular disease after kidney transplantation.
judgments.rationale: The review discusses recurrence patterns and emerging treatment approaches for glomerular disease in kidney allografts.

entries.query: How accurately does bioimpedance assess hydration in children with CKD on dialysis?

judgments.title: Assessing the hydration status of children with chronic kidney disease and on dialysis: a comparison of techniques.
judgments.rationale: The longitudinal pediatric study directly compares bioimpedance and clinical hydration assessment and relates measures to blood pressure and cardiovascular indicators.

entries.query: Which extreme CKD-mineral bone disorder markers are associated with mortality in hemodialysis?

judgments.title: Association between Extreme Values of Markers of Chronic Kidney Disease: Mineral and Bone Disorder and 5-Year Mortality among Prevalent Hemodialysis Patients.
judgments.rationale: The study examines CKD-MBD laboratory markers in 1,126 hemodialysis patients and reports their associations with all-cause and cardiovascular mortality.

entries.query: Are lower achieved blood pressure levels associated with stroke and CKD progression in hypertensive CKD?

judgments.title: Impact of achieved blood pressure on renal function decline and first stroke in hypertensive patients with chronic kidney disease.
judgments.rationale: The randomized-trial analysis directly relates achieved BP levels to first stroke and CKD progression in hypertensive CKD patients.

entries.query: Does telehealth improve blood pressure control in nondialysis CKD?

judgments.title: Telehealth for the management of blood pressure in patients with chronic kidney disease: A systematic review.
judgments.rationale: The systematic review evaluates telehealth interventions for blood pressure in nondialysis CKD stages 3-5 and reports pooled BP and renal outcomes.

entries.query: How does endothelial dysfunction contribute to CKD across diabetes, pregnancy, transplant, and cancer therapy?

judgments.title: Endothelial factors in the pathogenesis and treatment of chronic kidney disease Part II: Role in disease conditions: a joint consensus statement from the European Society of Hypertension Working Group on Endothelin and Endothelial Factors and the Japanese Society of Hypertension.
judgments.rationale: The consensus review spans endothelial dysfunction across several kidney-affecting conditions and discusses clinical trial strategies and renal/cardiovascular outcomes.

entries.query: What hemoglobin response rates follow oral iron in iron-deficient nondialysis CKD?

judgments.title: Erythropoietic response to oral iron in patients with nondialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease in the FIND-CKD trial.
judgments.rationale: This post hoc FIND-CKD trial analysis quantifies hemoglobin response over time to oral iron in anemic, iron-deficient nondialysis CKD patients.

entries.query: How is anemia in chronic kidney disease identified and treated?

judgments.title: [ANEMIA IN CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE].
judgments.rationale: This clinical review covers the development and management of renal anemia in CKD and summarizes guidance on individualized hemoglobin targets.

entries.query: Do erythropoiesis-stimulating agents slow CKD progression or prevent AKI and transplant graft loss?

judgments.title: Erythropoiesis stimulating agents and reno-protection: a meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: The meta-analysis synthesizes controlled ESA trials across AKI, transplantation, and CKD and evaluates renal protection outcomes.

entries.query: How might HIF prolyl hydroxylase inhibitors treat anemia in CKD and what safety concerns remain?

judgments.title: Prolyl hydroxylase domain inhibitors as a novel therapeutic approach against anemia in chronic kidney disease.
judgments.rationale: This review explains the HIF-PHD mechanism, clinical development for CKD anemia, and potential systemic HIF safety concerns.

entries.query: Can iPSC-derived erythropoietin-producing cells improve renal anemia in CKD models?

judgments.title: Human pluripotent stem cell-derived erythropoietin-producing cells ameliorate renal anemia in mice.
judgments.rationale: The translational study creates EPO-producing cells from human iPSCs and reports improved renal anemia after transplantation in CKD mice.

entries.query: Do neuropathy screening questions add cardiovascular prognostic information in T2D with CKD or CVD?

judgments.title: Three-question set from Michigan Neuropathy Screening Instrument adds independent prognostic information on cardiovascular outcomes: analysis of ALTITUDE trial.
judgments.rationale: This ALTITUDE analysis tests neuropathy screening questions for added cardiovascular prognostic information in high-risk T2D participants with CKD and/or CVD.

entries.query: Does urate-lowering therapy prevent CKD progression or cardiovascular complications?

judgments.title: Uric acid lowering therapies for preventing or delaying the progression of chronic kidney disease.
judgments.rationale: The Cochrane review evaluates benefits and harms of urate-lowering therapy for CKD progression and cardiovascular endpoints, reporting certainty and follow-up limitations.

entries.query: What cardiovascular risk is observed in people whose treatment changes under revised blood pressure guidelines?

judgments.title: Incidence of cardiovascular disease in individuals affected by recent changes to US blood pressure treatment guidelines.
judgments.rationale: The cohort analysis compares cardiovascular incidence in people whose hypertension management recommendations differ under US guidelines.

entries.query: How do waist circumference and BMI relate to metabolic, cardiovascular, and renal outcomes in pediatric CKD?

judgments.title: Waist Circumference and Body Mass Index in Children with Chronic Kidney Disease and Metabolic, Cardiovascular, and Renal Outcomes.
judgments.rationale: This cross-sectional pediatric CKD study compares waist circumference and BMI against metabolic, cardiovascular, and renal health measures.

entries.query: Which nontraditional biomarkers may identify residual renal and cardiovascular risk in treated T2D?

judgments.title: Residual renal and cardiovascular disease risk in conventionally-treated patients with type 2 diabetes: the potential of non-traditional biomarkers.
judgments.rationale: The review focuses on residual renal and cardiovascular risk and discusses nontraditional biomarkers and newer glucose-lowering therapies in T2D.

entries.query: How does the adenine diet model reproduce chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease in rats?

judgments.title: Adenine-induced chronic kidney disease in rats.
judgments.rationale: This review describes adenine diet rat models of CKD, including progressive kidney damage, cardiovascular disease, and model limitations.

entries.query: Is hepatitis B infection associated with CKD or end-stage kidney disease risk?

judgments.title: Association between hepatitis B virus and chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: The meta-analysis evaluates HBV status against CKD, reduced GFR, proteinuria, and end-stage kidney disease across population studies.

entries.query: Does paricalcitol improve cardiovascular or renal outcomes in CKD, and what adverse effects occur?

judgments.title: Effects of paricalcitol on cardiovascular outcomes and renal function in patients with chronic kidney disease : A meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: This RCT meta-analysis evaluates paricalcitol cardiovascular and renal effects in CKD and reports hypercalcemia and kidney function outcomes.

entries.query: What renal outcomes and survival predictors occur in AA amyloidosis with kidney involvement?

judgments.title: Clinical outcomes and survival in AA amyloidosis patients.
judgments.rationale: This retrospective cohort studies biopsy-proven AA amyloidosis with renal involvement and reports dialysis, kidney failure predictors, and survival.

entries.query: Does dapagliflozin improve GFR or proteinuria in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis?

judgments.title: Dapagliflozin in focal segmental glomerulosclerosis: a combined human-rodent pilot study.
judgments.rationale: This human and rodent pilot directly tests dapagliflozin in FSGS and reports GFR, renal hemodynamics, proteinuria, and blood pressure outcomes.

entries.query: Do RAAS blockers change survival, cardiovascular, or renal outcomes in diabetes with advanced nondialysis CKD?

judgments.title: Effect of renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system blockade in adults with diabetes mellitus and advanced chronic kidney disease not on dialysis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
judgments.rationale: The review pools randomized trials of RAAS blockade in diabetes with CKD stages 3-5 and reports survival, cardiovascular, and renal endpoints.

entries.query: Is nephrolithiasis associated with later CKD or end-stage kidney disease?

judgments.title: Nephrolithiasis as a risk factor of chronic kidney disease: a meta-analysis of cohort studies with 4,770,691 participants.
judgments.rationale: The meta-analysis pools cohort data on nephrolithiasis and subsequent CKD and end-stage kidney disease risk.

entries.query: How do tacrolimus and mycophenolate compare for induction treatment of lupus nephritis?

judgments.title: Tacrolimus versus mycophenolate mofetil for induction therapy of lupus nephritis: a randomised controlled trial and long-term follow-up.
judgments.rationale: The randomized study directly compares tacrolimus and mycophenolate induction in active lupus nephritis and follows renal response and longer-term outcomes.

entries.query: What clinical features and kidney outcomes are reported in Indian patients with ADPKD?

judgments.title: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease: Study of clinical characteristics in an Indian population.
judgments.rationale: This prospective Indian cohort reports ADPKD clinical manifestations, CKD stage, hypertension, family history, and progression to end-stage disease.
